Even though they had seen the marvelous power of God demonstrated in Egypt, and He had promised to give them the land, they became afraid and refused to go in and conquer it. It is truly amazing that we humans can limit God, as this verse says. But because He has given dominion of this earth to us humans (Genesis 1:28), God has to work through us humans to accomplish His will, so that means that we have to cooperate with Him, or we limit Him. So many people think that God can just do anything He wants, but He has limited Himself to working through us, and that means that we do limit God when we don’t follow His leading. This sure does show that the “sovereignty of God” doctrine is untrue, as they say that God just controls everything that happens. They teach that nothing happens without His approval – Not true, and it is blasphemy against the Holy Ghost (Matthew 12:31-32). Wow, what power God has given us, and we need to use it for the glory of God in all we do. Thank you Lord for giving us dominion over this earth – Praise God!
